controls.label: Frame size
controls.persistenceMeaning: Cross-axis percentage used to compile equal documentary-frame dimensions.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes outer frame size, inner source box, track safety minimum, and visible-card count while preserving IDs/order/station semantics.
controls.causalTest: At t=0.44, 35 and 90 must differ in card dimensions and visible count; identity order and focused source must match.

controls.label: Frame gap
controls.persistenceMeaning: Design-pixel separation between ordered documentary frames.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes natural track step and adjacent spacing; it never changes source order, station, or source pixels.
controls.causalTest: At a hold, 8 and 80 must change adjacent station distances while selected source and card sizes remain equal.

controls.label: Station position
controls.persistenceMeaning: Fixed inspection-station coordinate along the horizontal or vertical active axis.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Moves station and recompiles offstage-safe track length; all sources keep order and equal frame geometry.
controls.causalTest: At a hold, 25 and 75 must move station and registered card by the declared axis amount; cross-axis and ID must match.

controls.label: Focus lift
controls.persistenceMeaning: Maximum source-safe physical separation of the card registered at station.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes perpendicular lift of station envelope only; source opacity/filter and non-focused track coordinates remain unchanged.
controls.causalTest: At a station hold, 50 must produce greater lift than 0 while source treatment and all along-axis coordinates match.

controls.label: Labels
controls.persistenceMeaning: Visibility of stable editorial index and caption apparatus outside artwork.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Changes label records/render visibility only; card geometry, timeline, source order, and source treatment are identical.
controls.causalTest: All four options must change only declared label visibility and preserve the complete numeric card state.
